defs.def: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food. Potatoes, beans and onions are all vegetables. 蔬菜

ex.s: Before _____64_____ (head) home, they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, at prices significantly _____65_____ (cheap) than those found in supermarkets.
ex.t: 在____（回家）之前，他们把购物袋装满当地农民种的新鲜果蔬，价格比超市里____（便宜）得多。

ex.s: For two weeks in March, Greenwich Village’s Blue Hill restaurant was renamed wastED, and served items like fried skate cartilage, a juice pulp burger, and a dumpster diver’s vegetable salad.
ex.t: 有两周时间（在三月），格林尼治村的Blue Hill餐厅改名为wastED，供应诸如炸鳐鱼软骨、果渣汉堡，以及“拾荒者蔬菜沙拉”等菜品。

ex.s: To sell home-grown vegetables.
ex.t: 为了卖自家种的蔬菜。

ex.s: She planted vegetables.
ex.t: 她种了蔬菜。

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Several times a year, students cook the vegetables they grow, and they occasionally make salads for their entire schools.
ex.t: 每年有几次，学生们会烹饪自己种的蔬菜，偶尔还会为全校制作沙拉。

ex.s: Program evaluations show that kids eat more vegetables as a result of the classes.
ex.t: 项目评估显示，由于这些课程，孩子们吃了更多的蔬菜。

ex.s: Some students get so interested in gardening that they bring home seeds to start their own vegetable gardens.
ex.t: 一些学生对园艺非常感兴趣，以至于把种子带回家，开辟自己的菜园。

ex.s: Growing Vegetable LoversD.
ex.t: 培养蔬菜爱好者 D.

ex.s: Probably fish and chips, or a Sunday dinner of meat and two vegetables.
ex.t: 可能是炸鱼薯条，或者是一份肉配两种蔬菜的周日晚餐。

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: We waste more vegetables than meat.
ex.t: 我们浪费的蔬菜比肉类多。

ex.s: You can plant a tree，make a meal with locally grown vegetables，or save power—the possibilities are endless.
ex.t: 你可以种一棵树，用本地种植的蔬菜做一顿饭，或者节约用电——可能性是无穷的。

ex.s: In their spare time, they are interesting in planting vegetables in their garden, that is on the rooftop of their house.
ex.t: 在业余时间，他们对在花园里种菜很感兴趣，花园就在他们房子的屋顶上。

ex.s: They often get up earlier and water the vegetables together.
ex.t: 他们经常起得很早，一起浇菜。

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables!
ex.t: 夏天来了的时候，他们会邀请学生来摘蔬菜！

ex.s: In their spare time, they are interesting in planting vegetables in their garden, that is on the rooftop of their house.
ex.t: 在业余时间，他们对在花园里种菜很感兴趣，花园就在他们房子的屋顶上。

ex.s: They often get up earlier and water the vegetables together.
ex.t: 他们经常起得很早，一起浇菜。

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables！
ex.t: 夏天到来时，他们会邀请学生们来摘蔬菜！

defs.def: a person who is physically alive but not capable of much mental or physical activity, for example because of an accident or illness 植物人

ex.s: The 4_____ makes it difficult for us to grow enough vegetables and fruit.
ex.t: （4）_____使我们难以种出足够的蔬菜和水果。

ex.s: Expert gardeners know just the right corner for roses, and others spend hours trying to grow perfect vegetables to enter into competitions.
ex.t: 园艺高手知道种玫瑰的最佳角落，而另一些人则花数小时培育完美的蔬菜去参赛。

ex.s: We all love roast beef and vegetables, but Mum says we'd better not eat too much roast food as it may make us suffer from heat inside our bodies, according to traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.t: 我们都爱吃烤牛肉和蔬菜，但妈妈说，按中医说法，最好别吃太多烧烤食物，以免体内上火。

ex.s: We like cooking at home and make our meals from fresh, seasonal fruit and vegetables.
ex.t: 我们喜欢在家做饭，用应季的新鲜果蔬做餐食。

ex.s: I know we should eat more fresh fruit and vegetables, but ready meals are so convenient.
ex.t: 我知道应该多吃新鲜水果蔬菜，但方便食品实在太省事了。

defs.def: a person who has a boring life 生活单调乏味的人
